answer: Each identity locks a 50-credit bond for a summit check-in. A ripple of challenges hits all identities simultaneously, and the terrace plan gives each identity one seat and operator slot, so no operator covers two identities. Each fake needs one operator: 70 per epoch plus the 50 bond, 120 each; the k-th fake needs a new operator, so 1,000 fakes cost 120,000 per epoch. A rented attendance ring fails: key-bound challenges cannot be sequenced, late answers forfeit the bond, and the log exposes shared operators. An honest agent pays 50 once, attends once, and keeps the bond.
